main_value_proposals.before: Recovery eventually occurred, but conservative investment in land, weak entrepreneurship, and older economic structures persisted or were reinforced.
main_value_proposals.proposed: Recovery eventually occurred, but conservative investment in land, weak entrepreneurship, and older economic structures persisted or were reinforced. Internal customs and corporate barriers were removed, but these legal preconditions did not overcome uncertainty, land-oriented investment and weak productive enterprise.

main_value_proposals.before: The Revolution ended noble corporate status, feudal and fiscal privilege, venal ennoblement and automatic deference. Emigration, confiscation, execution and failed return caused trauma, but property recovery and later elite continuity limit any claim of total material destruction.
main_value_proposals.proposed: The Revolution ended noble corporate status, feudal and fiscal privilege, venal ennoblement and automatic deference. Emigration, confiscation, execution and failed return caused trauma, but property recovery and later elite continuity limit any claim of total material destruction. The Society of Thirty deliberately exploited divisions within the educated elite to mobilize support for an undivided legislature, helping convert a reform-minded order into a presumed enemy.

main_value_proposals.before: The Revolution dismantled the Gallican Church's corporate resources, dissolved monastic life, divided oath-taking and refractory clergy, and subjected priests and worship to persecution. Nuns overwhelmingly opposed convent dissolution, unlike many released monks; the Concordat did not restore the former corporate or cloistered order.
main_value_proposals.proposed: The Revolution dismantled the Gallican Church's corporate resources, dissolved monastic life, divided oath-taking and refractory clergy, and subjected priests and worship to persecution. Nuns overwhelmingly opposed convent dissolution, unlike many released monks; the Concordat did not restore the former corporate or cloistered order. Refractory priests faced deprivation and persecution, while constitutional priests lost papal recognition and widespread popular legitimacy; the two camps suffered different forms of exclusion.

main_value_proposals.before: Crisis, legislation, institutional destruction, inflation, and war made the Revolution an economic disaster that set French expansion back by a generation.
main_value_proposals.proposed: Crisis, legislation, institutional destruction, inflation, and war made the Revolution an economic disaster that set French expansion back by a generation. The initial economic shocks also shaped hopes in the Estates-General, made cheap bread a test of Parisian patriotism, and turned rural fears into pressure for anti-feudal concessions.
